Author: P.K. Lohra Bench: P.K. Lohra  HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR  S.B. Criminal Misc. Bail No. 9685 / 2017 Ashok Kumar Upadhyay S/o Ratanlal, By Caste Upadhyay, R/o Near Hariramji Mandir, Purani Lane, Gangasahar, District Bikaner.
(Presently Lodged At Central Jail, Bikaner)
 ----Petitioner  Versus State of Rajasthan  ----Respondent _____________________________________________________ For Petitioner(s) : Mr. S.D. Purohit.
For Respondent(s) : Mr. K.V. Vyas, PP for the State.
_____________________________________________________  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE P.K. LOHRA Order 30/10/2017 The instant bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is filed by petitioner arising out of FIR No.96/2017, registered at Police Station Naal, District Bikaner for offences punishable under Sections 420, 272, 467, 468, 471 & 120B IPC and Sections 51A, 53A & 63 of the Copyright Act.

entities.text: HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE FOR RAJASTHAN AT  JODHPUR
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is argued by learned counsel that petitioner has been falsely implicated in the matter.

Learned counsel has further submitted that the entire proceedings undertaken by police in the matter is wholly without jurisdiction and dehors Sections 41, 42 & 47 of the Food Safety and Standards Act,
2006.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor has opposed the bail application of petitioner.
[CRLMB-9685/2017] Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on merits of case, I feel persuaded to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the bail application under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed and it is ordered that accused-petitioner Ashok Kumar Upadhyay S/o Ratanlal, arrested in connection with F.I.R.
No.96/2017, Police Station Naal, District Bikaner, may be released on bail; provided he furnishes a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- with two surety bonds of like amount to the satisfaction of learned trial Court with the stipulation to appear before that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
